scope: EFSA practical arrangements implementing the Transparency Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2019/1381) for proactive disclosure and confidentiality: the definition of sanitisation, the personal-data rule for non-confidential versions, the minimum content of confidentiality requests, the implementation of confidentiality decisions, and the Annex closed list of items that may be claimed confidential, by sector (Annex letters a to h). Drives the sanitisation step and grounds its assistant. Articles 5, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15, 17 and 18 (publication timelines, re-use, decision deadlines, confirmatory applications, withdrawal, professional secrecy, impartiality) are not encoded.

guidance.title: Decision of the Executive Director of the European Food Safety Authority laying down practical arrangements concerning transparency and confidentiality
guidance.author: European Food Safety Authority (Executive Director)
guidance.citation: EFSA, 2021. Decision of the Executive Director of the European Food Safety Authority laying down practical arrangements concerning transparency and confidentiality, ver. 2 - 18.01.2021, applicable from 27 March 2021. Implements Articles 38 to 39e of Regulation (EC) No 178/2002 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2019/1381.

guidance.title_check_phrase: Laying down practical arrangements concerning transparency and confidentiality

a.label: General Food Law (Art. 39) — submissions not covered by b–h

entries.title: Definition of sanitisation
entries.requirement: Sanitisation masks (or unmasks) information according to a confidentiality request or decision, and includes masking personal data under Article 39e(2) GFL.
entries.quote: means the process of masking or unmasking scientific data, studies and other information in accordance with a confidentiality request or with a confidentiality decision, including the masking of personal data in accordance with Article 39e(2) of Regulation (EC) No 178/2002
guidance_anchors: means the process of masking or unmasking scientific data, studies and other information in accordance with a confidentiality request or with a confidentiality decision
including the masking of personal data in accordance with Article 39e(2)

entries.title: No personal data in non-confidential versions
entries.label: Art. 4(5) PA / Art. 39e GFL
entries.legal_basis: Article 4(5) of the EFSA practical arrangements; Article 39e of Regulation (EC) No 178/2002
entries.requirement: Non-confidential versions must contain no personal data of any kind, except the applicant's name and address and the names of authors of published or publicly available studies. Information on identified or identifiable persons must be absent, sanitised or anonymised.
entries.quote: shall not contain personal data of any kind, with the exception of the name and address of the applicant, where applicable, and the names of authors of published or publicly available studies. Particular attention should be paid so as to ensure the absence, sanitisation or anonymisation, as appropriate, of information relating to identified or identifiable persons
guidance_anchors: shall not contain personal data of any kind, with the exception of the name and address of the applicant
the names of authors of published or publicly available studies
the absence, sanitisation or anonymisation, as appropriate, of information relating to identified or identifiable persons

entries.title: Non-confidential versions are published as submitted
entries.requirement: The non-confidential version submitted by the applicant is published without delay once the application is valid or admissible; supplementary information is published on receipt.
entries.quote: Non-confidential versions – as submitted by applicants – of scientific data, studies and other information part of, or supporting, an application shall be made public by the Authority, without delay, once a valid or admissible application has been received by the Authority
guidance_anchors: as submitted by applicants – of scientific data, studies and other information part of, or supporting, an application shall be made public by the Authority, without delay

entries.title: Updated version after sanitisation
entries.requirement: Where documents are subject to confidentiality requests, or need sanitisation because requests were rejected, EFSA publishes the updated version after sanitisation under Article 13.
entries.quote: Where the information, studies, documents or data referred to in paragraph 1 are the subject of confidentiality requests or require sanitisation due to the rejection of confidentiality requests submitted by applicants, the Authority shall make public the updated version of the relevant document following its sanitisation
guidance_anchors: require sanitisation due to the rejection of confidentiality requests submitted by applicants
the Authority shall make public the updated version of the relevant document following its sanitisation

entries.title: Only Annex items, with verifiable justification
entries.requirement: Confidentiality may be requested only for parts of the submission that fall within the Annex items and are supported by verifiable justification under Article 10.
entries.quote: Confidentiality requests may be submitted only with respect to certain parts of the submitted information [...] they fall within the scope of the information items listed in the Annex; and [...] verifiable justification is provided proving compliance with Article 10
guidance_anchors: Confidentiality requests may be submitted only with respect to certain parts of the submitted information
they fall within the scope of the information items listed in the Annex
verifiable justification is provided proving compliance with Article 10

entries.title: Precise identification of the masked parts
entries.requirement: A request must identify the exact paragraph, page, line or part precisely enough to exclude anything not covered. Masking is therefore limited to the exact span, not whole pages or sections.
entries.quote: a clear identification of the relevant parts of the submitted information that, in their opinion, qualify for confidential treatment, accompanied by a link to and a detailed reference to the exact paragraph, page, line or part thereof as appropriate, where this information is located, in a sufficiently precise manner so as to exclude any information that is not subject to the confidentiality request
guidance_anchors: a detailed reference to the exact paragraph, page, line or part thereof as appropriate
in a sufficiently precise manner so as to exclude any information that is not subject to the confidentiality request

entries.title: Cumulative requirements of the justification
entries.requirement: The justification must show the information is not public, that disclosure may significantly harm the applicant (at least 5% of gross annual turnover or earnings, or a specific reason), that it is lawfully held, whether it is environmental information, and that it is no older than five years or why it still matters.
entries.quote: not publicly available or is known only to a limited number of persons [...] may potentially harm the interests of the applicant to a significant degree [...] corresponding at least to 5% of the gross annual turnover [...] has been finalised in the form in which it was submitted to the Authority up to five (5) years prior to the submission of the confidentiality request
guidance_anchors: not publicly available or is known only to a limited number of persons
may potentially harm the interests of the applicant to a significant degree
corresponding at least to 5% of the gross annual turnover
has been finalised in the form in which it was submitted to the Authority up to five (5) years prior to the submission of the confidentiality request

entries.title: Implementation by blackening
entries.requirement: EFSA implements its decisions by revising the public version, and sanitises its own documents by blackening all information granted confidential status.
entries.quote: The Authority shall carry out the sanitisation of the documents it develops, adopts or otherwise produces by ensuring the blackening of all information, documents or data to which it grants confidential status
guidance_anchors: by revising the public (non-confidential) version
by ensuring the blackening of all information, documents or data to which it grants confidential status

entries.title: Confidential items relating to foreseeable effects
entries.requirement: When a scientific output contains information on foreseeable effects on human or animal health or the environment relating to items granted confidential status, EFSA reviews the decision; those elements may have to be made public (Art. 39c GFL).
entries.quote: Upon adoption by the Authority of a scientific output (i) containing information relating to foreseeable effects on human health, animal health or the environment, and (ii) when these effects relate to items that have been granted confidential status
guidance_anchors: containing information relating to foreseeable effects on human health, animal health or the environment
when these effects relate to items that have been granted confidential status

entries.title: Claimed items are not disclosed pending the decision
entries.requirement: Items under a confidentiality request, or granted confidential status, are not disclosed to unauthorised third parties, unless urgent action is essential to protect human health, animal health or the environment (Art. 39(4)(a) GFL).
entries.quote: are not disclosed to unauthorised third parties, unless this becomes necessary where urgent action is essential for the purposes of protecting human health, animal health or the environment
guidance_anchors: are not disclosed to unauthorised third parties, unless this becomes necessary where urgent action is essential

entries.title: Manufacturing or production process
entries.label: Art. 39(2)(a) GFL
entries.safety_exception: except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
entries.requirement: The manufacturing/production process, its method and innovative aspects, and technical and industrial specifications inherent to it may be claimed confidential, except information relevant to the safety assessment.
entries.quote: the manufacturing or production process, including the method and innovative aspects thereof, as well as other technical and industrial specifications inherent to that process or method, except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
guidance_anchors: the manufacturing or production process, including the method and innovative aspects thereof
other technical and industrial specifications inherent to that process or method

entries.title: Commercial links between producer/importer and applicant
entries.label: Art. 39(2)(b) GFL
entries.requirement: Commercial links between a producer or importer and the applicant or authorisation holder may be claimed confidential.
entries.quote: commercial links between a producer or importer and the applicant or the authorisation holder, where applicable
guidance_anchors: commercial links between a producer or importer and the applicant or the authorisation holder

entries.title: Sourcing, market shares or business strategy
entries.label: Art. 39(2)(c) GFL
entries.requirement: Commercial information revealing the applicant's sourcing, market shares or business strategy may be claimed confidential.
entries.quote: commercial information revealing sourcing, market shares or business strategy of the applicant
guidance_anchors: commercial information revealing sourcing, market shares or business strategy of the applicant

entries.title: Quantitative composition
entries.label: Art. 39(2)(d) GFL
entries.safety_exception: except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
entries.requirement: The quantitative composition of the subject matter of the request may be claimed confidential, except information relevant to the safety assessment.
entries.quote: quantitative composition of the subject matter of the request, except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
guidance_anchors: quantitative composition of the subject matter of the request, except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety

entries.title: Personal data, with three exceptions
entries.label: Art. 39e(1) GFL
entries.requirement: Personal data are protected, except (a) the applicant's name and address, (b) names of authors of published or publicly available studies, (c) names of participants and observers of Scientific Committee/Panel meetings and their working groups. Those three are not masked.
entries.quote: any personal data except for (a) the name and address of the applicant; (b) the names of authors of published or publicly available studies supporting such requests; and (c) the names of all participants and observers in meetings of the Scientific Committee and the Scientific Panels, their working groups and any other ad hoc group meeting on the subject matter
guidance_anchors: any personal data except for
the names of authors of published or publicly available studies supporting such requests
the names of all participants and observers in meetings of the Scientific Committee and the Scientific Panels

entries.title: Names and addresses of testing personnel
entries.label: Art. 39e(2) GFL
entries.requirement: Names and addresses of individuals involved in testing on vertebrate animals or in obtaining toxicological information (study directors, investigators, pathologists, technicians, QA staff) are masked.
entries.quote: personal data (names and addresses) of individuals involved in testing on vertebrate studies or in obtaining toxicological information
guidance_anchors: personal data (names and addresses) of individuals involved in testing on vertebrate studies or in obtaining toxicological information

entries.title: DNA sequence information (GMO)
entries.label: Art. 30(2)(a) Reg. 1829/2003
entries.safety_exception: except for sequences used for the purpose of detection, identification and quantification of the transformation event
entries.requirement: DNA sequence information may be claimed confidential, except sequences used to detect, identify and quantify the transformation event.
entries.quote: DNA sequence information, except for sequences used for the purpose of detection, identification and quantification of the transformation event
guidance_anchors: DNA sequence information, except for sequences used for the purpose of detection, identification and quantification of the transformation event

entries.title: Breeding patterns and strategies (GMO)
entries.label: Art. 30(2)(b) Reg. 1829/2003
entries.requirement: Breeding patterns and strategies may be claimed confidential.
entries.quote: breeding patterns and strategies
guidance_anchors: breeding patterns and strategies

entries.title: Study plan of efficacy studies (feed additives)
entries.label: Art. 18(3)(a) Reg. 1831/2003
entries.requirement: The study plan for efficacy studies of a feed additive may be claimed confidential.
entries.quote: the study plan for studies demonstrating the efficacy of a feed additive in terms of the aims of its intended use as defined in Article 6(1) of, and Annex I to Regulation (EC) No 1831/2003
guidance_anchors: the study plan for studies demonstrating the efficacy of a feed additive in terms of the aims of its intended use

entries.title: Impurity specifications and in-house methods (feed additives)
entries.label: Art. 18(3)(b) Reg. 1831/2003
entries.safety_exception: except for impurities that may have adverse effects on animal health, human health, or the environment
entries.requirement: Specifications of impurities of the active substance and the applicant's in-house analytical methods may be claimed confidential, except impurities that may have adverse effects on animal or human health or the environment.
entries.quote: specifications of the impurities of the active substance and the relevant methods of analysis developed internally by the applicant, except for impurities that may have adverse effects on animal health, human health, or the environment
guidance_anchors: specifications of the impurities of the active substance and the relevant methods of analysis developed internally by the applicant
except for impurities that may have adverse effects on animal health, human health, or the environment

entries.title: Starting substances, mixtures, impurities and migration results (FCM)
entries.label: Art. 20(2)(a) Reg. 1935/2004
entries.safety_exception: except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
entries.requirement: Detailed descriptions of starting substances and mixtures, compositions, manufacturing methods, impurities and migration testing results may be claimed confidential, except information relevant to the safety assessment.
entries.quote: any information provided in detailed descriptions of starting substances and mixtures used to manufacture the substance subject to the authorisation [...] impurities, and migration testing results, except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
guidance_anchors: any information provided in detailed descriptions of starting substances and mixtures used to manufacture the substance subject to the authorisation
impurities, and migration testing results

entries.title: Trademark and trade names (FCM)
entries.label: Art. 20(2)(b) Reg. 1935/2004
entries.requirement: The trademark of the substance and the trade names of the mixtures, materials or articles in which it is used may be claimed confidential.
entries.quote: the trademark under which the substance shall be marketed as well as the trade name of the mixtures, material or articles in which it shall be used
guidance_anchors: the trademark under which the substance shall be marketed as well as the trade name of the mixtures, material or articles in which it shall be used

entries.title: Starting substances and preparations (food additives, enzymes, flavourings)
entries.label: Art. 12(3)(a) Reg. 1331/2008
entries.safety_exception: except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
entries.requirement: Detailed descriptions of starting substances and preparations and how they are used to manufacture the substance, and of the materials or products in which it is used, may be claimed confidential, except information relevant to the safety assessment.
entries.quote: information provided in detailed descriptions of starting substances and starting preparations and on how they are used to manufacture the substance subject to the authorisation
guidance_anchors: information provided in detailed descriptions of starting substances and starting preparations and on how they are used to manufacture the substance subject to the authorisation

entries.title: Batch variability and stability data (food additives, enzymes, flavourings)
entries.label: Art. 12(3)(b) Reg. 1331/2008
entries.safety_exception: except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
entries.requirement: Detailed analytical information on the variability and stability of individual production batches may be claimed confidential, except information relevant to the safety assessment.
entries.quote: detailed analytical information on the variability and stability of individual production batches of the substance subject to the authorisation, except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
guidance_anchors: detailed analytical information on the variability and stability of individual production batches of the substance subject to the authorisation

entries.title: Impurity specification of the active substance (PPP)
entries.label: Art. 63(2)(b) Reg. 1107/2009
entries.safety_exception: except for the impurities that are considered to be toxicologically, ecotoxicologically or environmentally relevant and the related methods of analysis for such impurities
entries.requirement: The impurity specification of the active substance and its methods of analysis may be claimed confidential, except toxicologically, ecotoxicologically or environmentally relevant impurities and their methods.
entries.quote: the specification of impurity of the active substance and the related methods of analysis for impurities in the active substance as manufactured, except for the impurities that are considered to be toxicologically, ecotoxicologically or environmentally relevant
guidance_anchors: the specification of impurity of the active substance and the related methods of analysis for impurities in the active substance as manufactured
except for the impurities that are considered to be toxicologically, ecotoxicologically or environmentally relevant

entries.title: Results of production batches (PPP)
entries.label: Art. 63(2)(c) Reg. 1107/2009
entries.requirement: Results of production batches of the active substance, including impurities, may be claimed confidential.
entries.quote: results of production batches of the active substance including impurities
guidance_anchors: results of production batches of the active substance including impurities

entries.title: Complete composition of a plant protection product
entries.label: Art. 63(2)(d) Reg. 1107/2009
entries.requirement: Information on the complete composition of a plant protection product may be claimed confidential.
entries.quote: information on the complete composition of a plant protection product
guidance_anchors: information on the complete composition of a plant protection product

entries.title: Starting substances and preparations (novel foods)
entries.label: Art. 23(4)(a) Reg. 2015/2283
entries.safety_exception: except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
entries.requirement: Detailed descriptions of starting substances and preparations used to manufacture the novel food, and of the foods in which it is used, may be claimed confidential, except information relevant to the safety assessment.
entries.quote: information provided in detailed descriptions of starting substances and starting preparations and on how they are used to manufacture the novel food subject to the authorisation
guidance_anchors: used to manufacture the novel food subject to the authorisation

entries.title: Batch variability and stability data (novel foods)
entries.label: Art. 23(4)(b) Reg. 2015/2283
entries.safety_exception: except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
entries.requirement: Detailed analytical information on the variability and stability of individual production batches may be claimed confidential, except information relevant to the safety assessment.
entries.quote: detailed analytical information on the variability and stability of individual production batches, except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
guidance_anchors: variability and stability of individual production batches, except for information which is relevant to the assessment of safety
